# AIBrigade

> AIBrigade builds production-grade custom AI systems for U.S. Fintech and HealthTech companies — copilots, automation agents, GPT platforms, fraud detection models, clinical decision support, and predictive analytics — from discovery through production deployment.

AIBrigade is an AI engineering company founded in 2021, based in Perth Amboy, New Jersey, serving enterprises across the United States. The company has delivered 80+ AI systems, including 32 Fintech systems and 26 HealthTech systems, with over $340M in measured value delivered to clients.

## Services

- [AI in Fintech](https://aibrigade.ai/services#ai-fintech): Fraud detection, credit risk & underwriting, regulatory compliance automation (AML/KYC), algorithmic trading, and conversational banking agents.
- [AI in Healthcare](https://aibrigade.ai/services#ai-healthcare): HIPAA-compliant clinical documentation, diagnostic support, patient risk stratification, drug discovery, and population health analytics.
- [Custom AI Development](https://aibrigade.ai/services#custom-ai-development): End-to-end AI product development, from data strategy through model engineering, MLOps, and production deployment.
- [Automation & Integrations](https://aibrigade.ai/services#automation-integrations): AI-powered process automation, agent orchestration, and system integration.
- [AI in Retail](https://aibrigade.ai/services#retail): Personalization, demand forecasting, dynamic pricing, and agentic shopping assistants.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What does AIBrigade do?
A: AIBrigade builds production-grade custom AI systems for U.S. Fintech and HealthTech companies — copilots, automation agents, GPT-based platforms, fraud detection models, clinical decision support, and predictive analytics — taken from discovery through production deployment.

Q: What industries does AIBrigade specialize in?
A: Fintech (fraud detection, underwriting, compliance automation, algorithmic trading) and HealthTech (clinical documentation, diagnostics, patient risk stratification, HIPAA-compliant infrastructure), plus Retail AI and intelligent process automation.

Q: Is AIBrigade's healthcare AI HIPAA-compliant?
A: Yes. AIBrigade builds HealthTech AI systems with HIPAA compliance, auditability, and interpretability built in from day one.

Q: Does AIBrigade serve clients across the entire United States?
A: Yes. AIBrigade is nationwide, headquartered in Perth Amboy, New Jersey.

Q: How do I start a project with AIBrigade?
A: Contact the team at https://aibrigade.ai/contact to schedule a discovery call.
